# Commands Implement/Try recovery and visible style evidence

When matching content has a changed owning target, `try-fixup.mjs` creates separate `local-fixup-*` state with no Try attempts; it preserves the old monitor and correctly returns the amended target hash after interrupted recovery. [Task 4]

Scope: console.
